protocol.name: frozen high-resolution pixel head with learned full covariance in the deployed pose backend
protocol.dataset: 2012-02-18 validation development sequence; not an independent test sequence
protocol.baseline: SC2-PCR plus two-stage full-pool refinement at 1.2 m and 0.6 m
protocol.head: frozen high-resolution local pixel head plus train-only learned full 2x2 visual precision head
protocol.precision: absolute per-correspondence SPD matrices; no per-frame normalization
protocol.pose_backend: same bounded L-BFGS-B peak-then-pose objective, LiDAR information and bounds
